annotation: One annotator, Claude Opus 5.5, labeled every Python symbol each pull request changes outside its tests, from the diff and the files at its two commits, before reading the analyzer's output on it, and a reviewer, sergiparpal, then checked every label on a page that showed each symbol's diff and never the analyzer's findings, correcting 26 of the first 162 labels and 16 of the next 89. The first 60 cases came in two splits, the held_out ones labeled before the analyzer was changed against the development ones; once measured, those held_out cases joined development, and the 30 held_out cases of encode/django-rest-framework, jd/tenacity, urllib3/urllib3, agronholm/anyio, and pypa/packaging were labeled and reviewed before the analyzer's next change. reviewed_by names whoever checked a case's labels after the annotator.
